entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand sensor. I'm looking at my order number, it's VF-8675309.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Issue? The issue is that I completely changed my mind. It was a stupid impulse buy, and I don't use it. At all. I want my money back.
Okay, I understand. I just need to pull up your order information and review the return eligibility for you. Can you confirm the email address on the account?
It's myname@email.com. And you'd better hurry up. This is a complete waste of my time. If this isn't handled right now, I want to speak to your manager. I'm not playing games.
Thank you for that. Just one moment while the system loads... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. The delivery date was 34 days ago.
And? Are you going to give me a refund or not? I will light up every review site on the internet if you give me the runaround on this.
No runaround, sir. I've just checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window for a full refund.
Oh. So you're just going to do it then? No problem?

Yes, absolutely. I'm approving the return for you right now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label and instructions to the email on file. Once our warehouse receives the item, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.
Huh. Okay. Well, that's what I expected. Good. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great rest of your day.
